plan_declaration.name: lna-linearity
plan_declaration.scope: NOMINAL-CORNER nonlinear method qualification and first collection for design/lna_stage1 with IDEAL lossless L/C matching: two-tone IIP3 (spec row 7) and single-tone input P1dB (spec row 8). Rows 7 and 8 keep their ratified targets; a result here is a placeholder-circuit measurement at one corner (hbt_typ, 27 C, 2.5 V), not compliance and not an all-corner statement. The band (row 1) is still a DRAFT.

ports.source: ideal voltage source behind 50 ohm; open-circuit peak Vs per tone; available power per tone = Vs^2/(8*Z0)
ports.load: 50 ohm to ground at the DUT out port; a component of peak V delivers V^2/(2*Z0)
ports.input_axis: per-tone AVAILABLE source power (not absorbed power); the DUT input match is not ideal, so absorbed power differs
ports.gain: transducer gain = delivered load power / available source power

plan_declaration.placement_note: Both tones and both IM3 products (2f1-f2, 2f2-f1) lie inside the draft band; the single-tone P1dB frequency is the midpoint of each pair. Tone spacing 100 MHz.

sweep.axis: per-tone available input power (two-tone: each of two equal tones; single-tone: the one tone)
sweep.note: the two-tone sweep stops where the DUT leaves its operating limits plus a margin (IM3 fitting needs the uncompressed region); the single-tone sweep must reach the 1 dB crossing. A tighter solver is used for the two-tone IM3 products (they are 60-100 dB below the carriers) than for the single-tone compression sweep, where a tight solver aborts the transient at high drive (observed in method development).

time.note: window = 2 periods of the 100 MHz spacing; every analysed frequency (tones, IM3 products, floor probes at 50 MHz offsets) is an integer multiple of 1/window = 50 MHz, so the rectangular window is exactly coherent and no window correction applies. FFT bin spacing 50 MHz.

numerics.note: ngspice .options per request. Method-development probes (local, hbt_typ, 19.45 GHz tones) showed the integrator's truncation error creates spurious products AT the IM3 bins that the no-product floor-probe bins do not see (IM3 at -50 dBm per tone moved by ~0.3 dB between reltol 1e-6 and 1e-7/trtol=1, and by up to ~1.7 dB between 1e-5 and 1e-7), so IM3 needs the tight setting and the timestep-halving check is the qualification, not the floor probes alone.

extraction.floor_definition: numerical floor of a run = the larger of the delivered powers at two coherent bins that carry no tone, harmonic or intermodulation product (2f1-f2 minus 50 MHz, 2f2-f1 plus 50 MHz; single tone: f0 -/+ 50 MHz)

operating_limits.source: spec row 17 (no npn13G2 above 1.4 V V_CE; model card vce window 0.4-2.0 V) and the model-card V_BE box 0.65-0.96 V used by sim/lna-sparam-nf/stage1_tables.py
operating_limits.applied_to: instantaneous peak/minimum over the retained window for Q1 and Q2; the card Ic box is not monitored (instantaneous collector current is not saved)
operating_limits.rule: a sweep point that breaks a limit is classified 'outside DUT operating limits' and is excluded from fits and baselines; it is never fitted through

convergence.note: variants: base; half_step (solver max step and DFT grid halved, same window); double_window (same step, retained window doubled, same discard). A refined variant must reproduce the baseline estimator outcome within the tolerances; a failure is published as 'unconverged' and the number is not a result.

controls.description: memoryless cubic y = a1 x + a3 x^3 between the same 50 ohm terminations (closed forms in linearity.cubic_expectations): run through the identical generated ngspice block and extractor as the DUT

targets.source: spec/target-spec.md rows 7 and 8 (ratified, input-referred); unchanged by this plan

plan_declaration.dut_expected_corner_note: hbt_typ, 27 C, 2.5 V only. Corner dependence is a later campaign.
plan_declaration.development_note: Numerics, sweep ranges and the IM3 floor margin were fixed after ~10 local single-unit ngspice debug probes at the mid placement (run before this plan was committed); the limits, targets, tolerances of the closed-form controls and the convergence tolerances were not tuned on DUT results. The plan is committed before the collection and the record cites its commit.
